create_Step3ReasoningParser: create a Step3ReasoningParser instance with a tokenizer to parse reasoning and content from model output
extract_reasoning_streaming: extract reasoning and content from a streaming delta message using token IDs and text
extract_reasoning: extract reasoning and content from a complete model output string split by the </think> token
is_reasoning_end: test whether a sequence of input token IDs contains the </think> end-of-reasoning token
extract_content_ids: extract token IDs that appear after the </think> end-of-reasoning token in an input sequence
